nodes.description: Constant bytes32 slot holding the implementation address (EIP-1967 implementation slot).
Constant bytes32 slot holding the admin address (EIP-1967 admin slot).
Constructor: validates impl is non-zero, writes implementation slot and sets msg.sender as admin.
Only-admin function that overwrites the implementation slot with newImpl.
Public view returning the current implementation address stored in the slot.
Internal view helper reading a slot and casting it to address.
Internal view helper performing assembly sload on a given slot.
Internal helper performing assembly sstore of value_ into slot_.
Internal delegatecall forwarder that copies calldata, delegatecalls implementation__ and returns raw returndata.
Payable fallback that delegates the current call to the stored implementation address.
msg.sender: untrusted caller address used as admin and in the admin authorization check.
delegatecall(gas(), implementation__, ...) executes arbitrary untrusted implementation code in proxy storage context.
assembly sstore writing arbitrary slot/value pairs directly into proxy storage.
assembly sload reading raw storage slots.
constructor parameter impl: implementation address to store.
setImplementation parameter newImpl: new implementation address.
_getAddress parameter key: slot to read as address.
_getSlotValue parameter slot_: slot to read.
_setSlotValue parameter slot_: slot to write.
_setSlotValue parameter value_: value to write into the slot.
_delegate parameter implementation__: target address for delegatecall.
Named return variable impl of implementation().
Named return variable add of _getAddress().
Named return variable value_ of _getSlotValue().

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the admin slot via _setSlotValue, granting the caller privileged admin rights.
constructor parameter impl flows into _setSlotValue as the stored implementation value.
constructor calls _setSlotValue twice to initialize implementation and admin slots.
constructor writes the implementation address into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
constructor writes msg.sender into ADMIN_SLOT.
sstore in _setSlotValue mutates IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT when called with that slot.
sstore in _setSlotValue mutates ADMIN_SLOT when called with that slot.
setImplementation authorizes msg.sender against the stored admin address (require check).
setImplementation calls _getAddress(ADMIN_SLOT) for the authorization check.
setImplementation calls _setSlotValue to update the implementation slot.
newImpl parameter flows into _setSlotValue.
ADMIN_SLOT is read by _getAddress inside setImplementation.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the slot written by _setSlotValue in setImplementation.
implementation() calls _getSlotValue to read the implementation slot.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is passed as argument into _getSlotValue.
local impl is returned by implementation().
_getAddress calls _getSlotValue on the provided key.
key parameter of _getAddress flows into _getSlotValue.
local add is returned by _getAddress().
slot_ parameter is used by the assembly sload operation.
sload result is assigned to local value_.
local value_ is returned by _getSlotValue().
slot_ parameter is used as the sstore destination key.
value_ parameter is written by the sstore operation.
implementation__ parameter is the delegatecall target address.
_delegate executes the delegatecall unsafe operation.
delegatecall executes untrusted implementation code in proxy context, which can re-enter proxy functions such as setImplementation.
fallback calls _getAddress(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).
fallback calls _delegate with the resolved implementation address.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is read by _getAddress inside the fallback.
fallback indirectly triggers the delegatecall unsafe operation.

normalization_plan.reason: constructor parameter impl is only used as the value written by _setSlotValue; it can be normalized into that write operation.
newImpl is solely consumed by _setSlotValue as the implementation slot value.
key of _getAddress is forwarded directly to _getSlotValue and has no independent semantics.
slot_ of _getSlotValue is only the argument of the assembly sload.
slot_ of _setSlotValue is only the destination key of the assembly sstore.
value_ of _setSlotValue is only the stored value of the assembly sstore.
implementation__ of _delegate is only the delegatecall target address.
named return impl only carries the value returned by implementation().
named return add only carries the address returned by _getAddress().
named return value_ only carries the slot value returned by _getSlotValue().
